title: Cruiser Gloss White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Cruiser Gloss White is crafted for riders seeking low-profile styling with DOT baseline compliance, pairing low-profile styling with essential certified head protection. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1287g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~99 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Classic cruiser half with inner sun shield and padded comfort liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for open-face fit; requires chin strap adjustment for optimal stability on cruiser bikes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Daytona Cruiser Gloss White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Half lineup, the Cruiser Gloss White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Daytona Cruiser Gloss White represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Half helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Daytona Cruiser Gloss White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
